# George General Construction Company (GGCC)

> Turnkey Class-1 Licensed Electrical Contracting & Infrastructure Engineering Firm in India.

## Overview

George General Construction Company (GGCC) is a premier licensed electrical contracting firm headquartered in Sanpada, Navi Mumbai. GGCC delivers end-to-end electrical contracting, industrial plant electrification, high-voltage HT & LT cable laying, custom control panel fabrication, annual maintenance contracts (AMC), street lighting, and flameproof installations across 5 Indian states. GGCC serves as a major primary working partner with Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) for petrol pump electrification, canopy lighting, and civil works.

## Primary Industry Expertise

- **Turnkey Electrical Contracting**: End-to-end design, execution, testing, and regulatory CEIG approval.
- **HPCL Petrol Pump Specialization**: Canopy lighting, high mast erection, main distribution DBs, earthing pits, and civil trenching.
- **Industrial Electrification**: Sub-station commissioning, busbar trunking (BBT), VFD/MCC panels, and heavy cable pulling.
- **Commercial Building Electrification**: Concealed riser wiring, UPS power networks, APFC panels, and NBC code compliance.
- **Sub-Station & HT/LT Cabling**: Up to 33kV cable laying, trenchless HDD crossings, heat-shrink jointing, and megger testing.
- **Flameproof Installations**: PESO & CIMFR certified explosion-proof (Ex-d) electrical setups for Zone 1 & Zone 2 areas.
- **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)**: 24/7 emergency response, thermographic scanning, and transformer oil filtration.
